recipe.visualDefinition: A central rectangular photograph of a surreal coastal scene featuring a modern skyscraper emerging from the ocean next to a rugged cliff, set against a wide white border with subtle horizontal texture and classic serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale contrast between the organic cliff and the geometric skyscraper
Framing of the central image within a large textured white margin
Symmetrical vertical alignment of text above and below the image
Juxtaposition of urban architecture and wild natural seascape
coreInvariants: The skyscraper must be partially submerged in the water
The cliff must dominate the left side of the inner frame
The outer border must feature a subtle, repeating horizontal pattern

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The central image occupies approximately 60% of the total area, centered both horizontally and vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical spire of the skyscraper serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the top text, down the cliff face to the skyscraper, and finally to the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Generous white margins provide a clean, gallery-like presentation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white/light grey for the textured border and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blues and earthy browns within the central photograph.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Black for the sharp, high-contrast typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, natural saturation in the photo contrasts with the stark white and black of the layout.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or overly vibrant synthetic colors

composition.relationshipToImage: Centered above and below the frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both top and bottom text to maintain formal balance.
graphicDevices: Thin white border around the central image
Subtle horizontal line texture on the outer white background

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and sharp serifs
Provides the necessary formal structure and weight

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a central rectangular image of a rocky cliff on the left meeting a blue ocean on the right. In the water, place a tall, modern, triangular skyscraper (like the Transamerica Pyramid) partially submerged. Surround this image with a wide, off-white border featuring a very subtle horizontal linen or paper texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using a high-contrast serif font like Galliard, typeset the primary title centered in the top margin and the secondary title centered in the bottom margin. Ensure the kerning is tight and the color is solid black.

verificationChecks: Is the skyscraper correctly placed in the water?
Is the text centered and using a serif font?
Is the outer border textured and wide?
Is the cliff on the left side of the inner frame?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the horizontal background pattern
mustRedesign: Specific band names or album titles
postGenerationChecks: Check for vertical alignment of all elements
Ensure the skyscraper looks integrated into the sea spray
Verify the texture on the white border is visible but subtle
Confirm the serif font has high stroke contrast
recipe.reuseFormula: Central surreal photo + wide textured margin + centered high-contrast serif typography.
